summary: Expanding the 281-class model to 286 classes using the isolated Cotton_Leaves dataset (~197 images) failed the safety and regression gating criteria. Without the full multi-gigabyte 281-class rehearsal dataset available locally, the 5 newly initialized Cotton classes experienced severe logit inflation, causing a 92.79% regression on original classes, a 95.26% false cotton acceptance rate on non-cotton broadleaves, and an unacceptable spike in OOD confidence.

1_cotton_sealed_performance.metric: Macro F1: 71.48%, Balanced Acc: 67.62%, Overall Acc: 67.74%

6_safety_invariants.metric: All ambiguous and stress samples suppressed treatment (treatment_permitted = False)

7_production_firewall.metric: Model A and Campaign 2 SHA256 hashes strictly unchanged

recommendations: Do NOT deploy this research candidate to production or replace weights/efficientnet_b5_cbam_best.pt.

For Cotton disease diagnosis, utilize the dedicated 42-class model stack (which already contains 12 validated Cotton classes: Aphids, Bacterial Blight, Healthy, Anthracnose, Bollrot, Bollworm, Mealybug, Whitefly, etc.) in a cascaded architecture rather than attempting to fine-tune the 281-class classifier without its original training corpus.
If 286-class expansion is pursued in the future, the complete multi-gigabyte 281-class training dataset must be restored to provide balanced rehearsal across all 281 classes.
